_comment: Asian board for the 2026-09-17 slate (Taipei 09-18). Seventeenth slate of the prospective test. Nine games, which is the entire US card -- the first slate where the board and the card match exactly. No reading conflict: all nine favourites agree with the US moneyline, and the board's own moneyline column, shown in six of the nine, agrees as well. Tigers at White Sox is worth a note against my own prior: I read the handicap on Chicago's row and thought that looked wrong, since Detroit is the stronger club, but the market has the White Sox at 0.5108 with all fifteen books above even money and none below. The row reading was right and the prior was wrong, which is the same lesson the 09-05 rule was adopted for. Twins at Angels is quoted at a 0 handicap, where laying and receiving are the same wager, so the label carries no meaning -- the market there leans marginally to Minnesota at 0.5043. Red Sox at Rangers is the only game with a split total price, and it splits the unusual way: the over is cheaper at 0.930 with the under at 0.950. Handicaps flat at 0.950; every other total flat at 0.940.
